source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: On the minting page, please add an Optional gratuity feature.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: On the minting page, the tip feature now includes a custom option alongside presets of $2, $6, $14, and $30.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports that the minting-page tip feature now provides $2, $6, $14, and $30 presets plus a custom amount.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
By accident, I just completed 7 mints. For the first, I referred to #47 and added a $4 tip, but the tip failed: 0x84c2e719d50a6bf314e8c729630db5fa91d74e285c60b3a917f84d620e51ac39

For the second, I left the referral code blank, but its ticket and commission still do not appear on the leaderboard: 0x5e91c4a27d806bf314c8e729630db5fa81d74e295c60b3a917f84d620e51ac38

execution.observed_behavior: A mint using referral code #47 completed, but its selected $4 tip failed.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Using 'no referral code' and a '$4 tip', I have just completed another mint.

- The tip still does not work.

- For 'no referral code' purchases, tickets and commissions still appear neither on the leaderboard nor in the NFT attributes.

A second transaction, visible in the screenshot, appeared after the mint. I cancelled it, yet the mint completed normally. Was that extra transaction meant to send the tip, and why did it appear?

execution.observed_behavior: On a no-referral mint with a $4 tip, the mint completed but the tip did not; a separate post-mint transaction appeared and was cancelled.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Although the tip worked, we need a confirmation banner explaining that it is sent through a delayed follow-up transaction. Otherwise, buyers may think they’re being asked to purchase a second copy.

value_updates.delayed_follow_up_notice: Show a confirmation banner explaining that the tip is sent through a delayed follow-up transaction and is not a request to purchase a second copy.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: In your case, the $4 tip became a self-transfer because your wallet is currently set as the on-chain founderWallet, meaning no funds move when you tip yourself. I’ve now deployed a UI safeguard that disables tipping under that condition.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports deploying a UI safeguard that disables tipping when the connected wallet is the on-chain founder wallet, preventing self-tips.
Client confirms receipt of the $9 tip.

routing_warnings.description: The missing confirmation dialog concerns mint-result feedback; the same message's delayed tip transactions only provide context for the later tip-notice requirement.
